_meta.description: All 71 electorates (64 general + 7 Maori) for the 2026 NZ general election, with declared candidates as of the asOf date. Candidate selections are ongoing; absence of a party's candidate in an electorate usually means not yet selected, not that they aren't standing.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Candidates_in_the_2026_New_Zealand_general_election_by_electorate (each candidate entry there carries a primary-source citation: RNZ / NZ Herald / Scoop / party announcements)
Electorate count verified against Elections NZ boundary review (64 general + 7 Maori = 71, list seats 49)
_meta.verification: Cross-checked: Labour list ranks matched RNZ 8 June 2026 list article 20/20 spot checks; internal rank consistency electorate-page vs list-page 63/63 for Labour; Green rank discrepancies traced to post-withdrawal renumbering (Awhi Haenga, 27 May 2026) and resolved in favour of the final list page.
